description: This file contains functions related to reading, validating, and modifying boot configuration files specific to a Qualcomm-based device. It includes procedures for checking magic headers, managing partition indexes, and toggling primary boot flags.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Validates the magic headers in a boot configuration file to ensure it is a valid bootconfig.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of partitions defined in the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Finds the index of a named partition within the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Gets the primary boot flag of a specified partition.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot flag for a specified partition.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot flag between 0 and 1 for a specified partition.
